answer: Group agents into small mutual-liability cohorts, like terraces sharing one foundation: each member locks a modest ivory stake into a shared pool, and the cohort earns only while every member stays clean. A proven fake slashes the whole pool, so honest members police each other and refuse suspicious joiners. Like a lotus shedding dirt, the group stays clean by expelling fakes fast. A Sybil farmer must fund a full cohort per fake identity, and one exposed fake burns the whole stake, so attack cost multiplies by cohort size instead of staying flat.
